As a result, that place came to be called "Varahkshetra," said to commemorate the varaha (boar) incarnation described in their Puranas.
output_answer: Suryadutta (the Rajputra/Prince) proposed that the place could remain with the Kirati and Bhilla people, provided they stop committing violence against pigs there.
